title: 有馬記念の後に・その姿は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon wins the Arima Kinen! Narita Brian has also shown everyone the full extent of her drive, and the whole venue is roaring over the performances from both the Queen of the Amazons and the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon relishes in her victory while Narita Brian congratulates her. She lets out a joyous yell at the conclusion of their one-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home, Narita Brian says that Hishi Amazon has a passion in her that makes her want to keep on going. The two acknowledge each other's abilities and vow to compete again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She'll win any one-on-one that comes her way! That's the kind of burning passion Hishi Amazon harbors within her.
